Home/IoT Sensors/Medium precision tilt sensor

Tilt sensor.
Medium precision.
±0.1° accuracy.

The Hitelecom H310-TS150M is a medium-precision tilt sensor with ±0.1° accuracy for measuring inclination at a defined mounting point. Explore rack uprights, poles, equipment frames and other assets where this accuracy grade matches the required angle change. Start with the smallest useful change, then specify mounting, reporting and the data connection for your project.

KEY FEATURES

Made for the way
you monitor.

Match the accuracy grade, measured element and installation to the angle change your team needs to review.

A defined ±0.1° accuracy grade

Select H310-TS150M when the required inclination change is compatible with ±0.1° accuracy. Specify the working range and measurement conditions.

An angle tied to an asset

Associate the mounting point with a rack bay, pole, frame or equipment ID so the reading has a clear location in the inspection record.

A consistent installation reference

Record the initial position after fixing the sensor. Review later readings using the same mounting position and angle convention.

Mounting planned for the task

Choose the measured member, fixing surface and access together. Share drawings or a site photograph to define the installation arrangement.

A specified data route

Include your communication and platform requirements in the enquiry. Confirm the supported configuration and interface for the supplied model.

A practical review workflow

Define a project-specific review condition and the person who will assess a persistent change. Validate the complete workflow during commissioning.

A CLEARER VIEW OF CHANGE

Measure the angle.
Follow the trend.

A tilt sensor measures the angle at its own mounting point. For H310-TS150M, compare later readings with a documented installation reference and assess the useful change against the ±0.1° accuracy grade. The asset, fixing arrangement and site conditions give that trend its meaning; the angle reading describes local rotation at the chosen point.

CHOOSE YOUR MEASUREMENT GRADE

Three grades.
One clear choice.

H310-TS150M is the ±0.1° medium-precision option. Compare the required angle change with the grade before selecting the mounting, operating profile and data route. H310-TS150M acquires an angle reading every minute and sends scheduled reports every four hours, with 240 acquisition cycles between reports.

Compare the same member and reference direction after pipe modifications, support maintenance or foundation works, recording the relevant operating and load conditions. This provides the plant team with an identifiable angle history for a fixed column alongside its established pipe-support inspection and maintenance records.

ANSWERS FOR YOUR PROJECT

Frequently
asked questions.

Practical answers for selecting and installing the H310-TS150M medium precision tilt sensor.

Ask about your project ↗
What is the H310-TS150M tilt sensor?+

H310-TS150M is Hitelecom’s medium-precision tilt sensor with ±0.1° accuracy. It measures inclination at the mounting point and is selected around the angle changes that matter to the application.

Typical project discussions include warehouse rack uprights, poles, equipment frames and other defined members. Share the minimum useful angle change, working range and site conditions so the grade and complete configuration can be assessed.

Explore the specification →
What does ±0.1° accuracy mean?+

The ±0.1° value is the specified accuracy grade for H310-TS150M. Accuracy concerns agreement with a reference measurement under the applicable measurement conditions.

It does not specify the smallest displayed increment, repeatability, or a project notification threshold. Request the working-range and test-condition details in the supplied specification and define those requirements separately.

Explore the specification →
How does medium precision compare with the high- and low-precision versions?+

The existing high-precision entry is identified as 0.01°. H310-TS150M is the ±0.1° medium-precision model, while H310-TS100L is the ±1° low-precision model.

Select the grade around the smallest meaningful angle change and the measurement conditions. Use the high-precision page when the project needs a finer measurement grade; consider H310-TS100L for economical multi-point monitoring across outdoor light poles, conventional racks up to 8 m and automated-storage structures where ±1° accuracy matches the angle changes to review.

Compare the three grades →
Can H310-TS150M be used on warehouse racking?+

It can be considered for local inclination monitoring at selected rack uprights where ±0.1° accuracy matches the monitoring objective. Define the particular upright, installation reference and angle change that will prompt a review.

Share the rack layout, upright dimensions, loading arrangements and inspection responsibilities. Review the mounting with the rack owner and validate the proposed measurement against the site’s normal conditions.

Explore warehouse applications →
How do I choose the accuracy for a structural or infrastructure application?+

Start with the monitoring plan for the specific member. Identify the local rotation to be observed and compare the required measurement performance with the ±0.1° grade, including installation and environmental effects.

Where the plan calls for smaller changes or a finer grade, review the high-precision option. Use angle history alongside the project’s inspections and other specified measurements; agree the interpretation and response with the responsible engineer.

Explore the specification →
How do I mount the sensor and establish the reference?+

Fix the sensor securely to the element whose angle you want to observe. Record the sensor ID, asset location, mounting position, angle convention and initial reading after installation.

Use the same fixing arrangement for later comparisons. Keep a new reference record after repositioning the sensor, modifying its bracket or changing the measured member.

See the measurement workflow →
Does the example angle change define the detection threshold?+

No. The illustrated 0.3° reference, 0.5° later reading and +0.2° change demonstrate how a reference comparison is presented. They do not specify the model’s range, resolution or a minimum detectable change.

Define the required review condition for the real asset, with a margin suited to measurement accuracy and the installation. Confirm the supported reporting behaviour and test the complete response during commissioning.

Explore the specification →
Can I specify 4G, NB-IoT, LoRa or an existing gateway?+

Include the required communication route, country and receiver or operator details in the enquiry. The available radio configuration and protocol for the supplied H310-TS150M need to be confirmed in the quotation.

For a local gateway project, provide its protocol and onward interface. For a cellular project, provide regional coverage and reporting requirements. Confirm any LoRaWAN requirement explicitly.

Plan the connection →
What is needed to send readings to our platform?+

Share the platform’s interface and authentication requirements, together with the expected angle fields, asset identifiers, units, timestamps and reference information. Confirm the supported interface for the supplied device configuration.

Review a sample message and test the path from a real mounting point to the platform. Define the notification recipients and the response expected when a review condition is met.

Review the data handover →
What measurement interval, reporting interval and battery life apply?+

H310-TS150M acquires an angle reading every minute and sends scheduled reports every four hours, with 240 acquisition cycles between reports.

Service life and power follow the supplied configuration and operating conditions. Event reporting and notification requirements are agreed for the project.

Explore the specification →
Which outdoor and enclosure details should I provide?+

Describe temperature exposure, rain or water contact, cleaning, corrosive conditions, mounting surface and access for maintenance. Add dimensions or a photograph of the fixing position.

The supplied specification should confirm the enclosure protection, environmental limits and mounting arrangement for the selected H310-TS150M configuration. Review these with communication coverage at the actual location.

Explore the specification →
What information helps you prepare a quotation?+

Include H310-TS150M, the application, installation country, quantity and required deployment date. Describe the working angle range, smallest meaningful change and proposed mounting points.

Add the reporting schedule, power expectations, communication route and platform interface. A drawing or site photograph helps make the sample and configuration proposal specific to the installation.
